name: firstBlock
meaning: First block in address order: ((start+8+A-1)&~(A-1))-8 with A = max(align,32), written by Heap_InitArena 0x54d5f3. Heap_FindPrevBlock walks from here.

name: freeHead
meaning: Head of the free list; head->prev points to itself. Every free/unlink path compares against it. Once no free block is left it is the end sentinel.

name: endSentinel
meaning: Permanent 0x10-byte block at ((end-0x10)&~alignMask)-8, header 0x10 (0x11 when the block before it is free). next = itself; acts as the free-list terminator. Written only by Heap_InitArena.

name: alignMask
meaning: align-1, where align = max(CeilPow2(requested), 4); 3 for both shipped heaps. Allocation need = (size+8+alignMask)&~alignMask.

name: alignInvMask
meaning: ~(align-1), the AND mask used to round sizes and the sentinel address.

name: auxParam
meaning: Written only by Heap_InitAux 0x54da2c (0x8000 on the > 1 MB path), never read anywhere; stays 0 in the shipped game.

name: freeCount
meaning: Number of blocks on the free list, sentinel excluded; used as the search-loop bound by Heap_Alloc/Heap_AllocAligned. Set to 1 by Heap_InitArena, +1/-1 by Heap_Free, CarveBlock and AllocAligned.

name: smallMinSlot
meaning: Slot size of pool 0 in bytes (power of 2, at least 8). Pool p's bitmap word covers smallMinSlot << (p+5) bytes (Heap_AllocSmall 0x54e6d0). 0 when there are no pools.

name: smallMaxSlot
meaning: Largest size served by the pools = smallMinSlot << (nPools-1). Heap_Alloc tries Heap_AllocSmall when size <= this. 0 after Heap_InitArena and in the shipped game.

name: smallPoolBytes
meaning: Bytes per pool region = smallPool0Slots << smallMinShift; smallPoolShift = log2 of it. Written by Heap_InitSmallPools only.

name: smallPool0Slots
meaning: Slot count of pool 0 = total/(nPools*smallMinSlot); pool p has smallPool0Slots >> p slots (Heap_AllocSmall 0x54e6bc).

name: smallMinShift
meaning: log2 of the smallest small-block slot; pool i has slots of 1 << (smallMinShift + i) bytes (Heap_FreeSmall, 0x54e63d)

name: smallPoolShift
meaning: log2 of each small pool's region size; pool index = (ptr - smallBase) >> smallPoolShift

name: smallBase
meaning: start of the small-block pools; Heap_Free 0x54e2f1 sends ptr in [smallBase, smallEnd) to Heap_FreeSmall

name: smallBitmapWords
meaning: Start of the bitmap words, just after the nPools-entry pointer table (= smallBitmaps + nPools). Written by Heap_InitSmallPools; zeroed by Heap_InitArena.

name: smallEnd
meaning: end (exclusive) of the small-block pools, range test in Heap_Free 0x54e2f1

name: smallBitmaps
meaning: Per-pool bitmap pointers (MSB-first, set bit = free). This is also the user pointer of the single Heap_Alloc block that holds the pointer table, the bitmap words and the pool data; Heap_TermSmallPools frees it. NULL in the shipped game.
